subject.title: [Bug]: GitHub Copilot anthropic-messages transport silently hangs ~365s in isolated cron sessions (2026.5.27)

question: After live current-main Copilot cron proof, should aborted/no-output Copilot Claude runs enter model fallback, or should OpenClaw rely on the 60-second idle-timeout path plus cron error status?
rationale: The remaining choice changes retry behavior after an abort; it may recover delivery, but it can also repeat tool or outbound side effects if the run already did work.

options.title: Prove first, keep fallback narrow
options.body: Run live Copilot cron proof and allow fallback only for timeout failures before tool or outbound side effects are observed.

options.title: Fallback on aborted no-output results
options.body: Classify aborted/no-output Copilot results as fallback-worthy when configured fallbacks exist, accepting the duplicate-work risk.

options.title: Do not expand fallback
options.body: Keep current cron error surfacing and idle-timeout handling without adding a new aborted-result retry path.

recommendation.title: Prove first, keep fallback narrow
recommendation.body: Run live Copilot cron proof and allow fallback only for timeout failures before tool or outbound side effects are observed.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history on the Copilot Claude transport route and provider stream seams where the remaining policy would land.
